recipes.label: Support and reassure
recipes.description: Acknowledge a difficulty, then offer grounded support. Use only when the response does both.

recipes.label: Explore and consider
recipes.description: Open a question or possibility, then thoughtfully weigh it. Use for exploration followed by interpretation.

recipes.label: Consider and resolve
recipes.description: Weigh evidence or tradeoffs, then reach a clear recommendation. Do not use to imply certainty unsupported by the text.

recipes.label: Celebrate and appreciate
recipes.description: Recognize meaningful progress, then express warmth or gratitude. Avoid celebration for routine facts.
